TC-10/S26.title: Save Note outcome by which AI call fails, both modes
TC-10/S26.detail: Local QA stack on main 43c38a4f (round-companion-wt-qa, web :6473, Convex :4510); fresh @roundai.test physician per test; every ai/* action the page sent was answered or refused at the browser socket (pre-support.ts aiSocket: anything unscripted is refused), so no model ran; tripwire around every batch: 'no model call'. Spec newspec-c/pre-tc10-s26-faults.spec.ts (same rows and oracle as the 10-14 newspec-b run). R1 passes both modes: 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn’t be updated. Review the text and tap Save Note to retry.', the editor keeps the text, Generate disabled with 'did not finish processing'; a clean second Save enables Generate (Hospital shows '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: …'; Nursing Home shows no success message, only 'Saved 5:22 PM · Oct 15' — recorded, decision). R4 passes both modes (Nursing Home success message recorded the same way). R3 recorded (Q15): a failed task extraction shows 'The note was saved, but its follow-up tasks couldn’t be extracted.'; the next Save recovers both tasks, a third adds no duplicate. R2 FAILS both modes (U6 'yesterday's panels are never silently reused'): with a summary that comes back without its background and studies, Hospital says '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: vitals, labs, hospital course' and keeps yesterday's one-liner and 'Chest X-ray: right lower lobe infiltrate' on the panel with the summary's lastUpdatedAt re-stamped to today (usePreRoundProcess.ts sets it on every Save); Nursing Home shows no message at all over yesterday's one-liner and study. Unchanged since e02167f (the hook's background / radiology code did not change in 43c38a4f). Known: B05 (its partial-summary half; the 10-14 review proposed filing it apart, see candidates).
TC-10/S26.productIssue: When the summary returns without its background and studies, the physician sees a plain success ('✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: vitals, labs, hospital course' in Hospital; nothing in Nursing Home) while yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panels — and the Hospital Background is re-stamped as updated today — with no notice that those panels were not refreshed.
